Due to infrastructure limitations, no direct route exists between Center Alpha and Center Beta.
Furthermore, operational planning mandates that exactly one of the following two connections must be part of the final circuit: the link between Center Beta and Center Gamma, or the link between Center Gamma and Center Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed loop that visits every distribution center precisely once before returning to the point of origin.
